data.description: Brand New | Prime Location | Generously Sized
data.long_description:
Elite Residence stands as a beacon of luxury, consisting of 4 basement levels, a ground floor, and 86 floors, all featuring a contemporary design fused with a distinctive Victorian architectural style. Located in the iconic Dubai Marina, one of the most desirable districts in the emirate, this development promises a lifestyle of unmatched elegance.

Designed with no detail overlooked, Elite Residence offers a living experience that combines sophistication with ultimate comfort. The finest materials and fixtures from around the world have been carefully chosen to enhance the living spaces, creating an environment perfect for modern living. The development offers a range of luxurious living options, including penthouses and 1- to 2-bedroom apartments, allowing residents to indulge in the epitome of Dubai's high-end lifestyle.

Facilities & Amenities:

Private Car Parking
High-Speed Elevators
24-Hour Security
Indoor & Outdoor Swimming Pools
Multi-Function Room
Billiards & Table Tennis Rooms
Fully Equipped Gym

Jacuzzis
